candidate_policy.name: R3-BF
candidate_policy.kind: public-information Oracle/Breach timing and resource overlay
rules: Distinguish the Thassa's Oracle spell window from its ETB-trigger window; removing Oracle after the ETB trigger exists does not erase that trigger.
Resolved Ranger-Captain restricts Manual Transmission's noncreature spells but not creature answers such as Tishana's Tidebinder or Hope-Ender Coatl.
Resolved Silence, Orim's Chant targeting Manual Transmission, or Voice of Victory during Blue Farm's turn closes Manual Transmission spell-casting windows as applicable.

Track Underworld Breach graveyard fuel exactly. Countering one Brain Freeze storm trigger is not terminal while Breach remains and three distinct other graveyard cards can fund another escape after the original Brain Freeze resolves.
Track storm and Mindbreak Trap using spells actually cast by the relevant player; storm copies are not casts.

invariants: Oracle and Breach remain distinct terminal families
source removal does not erase an existing Oracle ETB trigger
Ranger does not illegally prohibit creature answers
Silence/Chant/Voice restrictions are applied to the correct player and turn
Breach rebuild requires exact distinct graveyard fuel
one Tidebinder storm-trigger counter is not scored terminal if legal rebuild remains
storm copies are not counted as casts
